a-semantic-control.role: Textless region/material/object-footprint control map for image generation.
a-semantic-control.fact_policy: Control input only; not puzzle truth.

a-imagegen-terrain-draft.role: Prompt-only no-furniture terrain candidate used to judge whole-scene generation.
a-imagegen-terrain-draft.prompt: Create a single orthographic top-down fantasy mystery map draft for a 6x6 puzzle board, inspired by a rainy fog-town bookstore courtyard. Divide the map into six readable zones: mossy garden, warm wood cafe, dark wood library, wet stone courtyard, stone workshop, and amber wood inn. Include only terrain, architecture, walls, floors, doors, paths, and empty room structure. No movable furniture, no bookshelves, no rugs, no trees, no shrubs, no fountain, no characters, no labels, no letters, no numbers, no visible grid lines.
a-imagegen-terrain-draft.fact_policy: Draft only; generated walls and doors cannot alter JSON regions.

b-layered-object.role: Pure terrain Image Layer plus transparent Object Layer and matrix-derived region border.
b-layered-object.fact_policy: Objects and borders are visual overlays only.

c-region-material.role: B plus region material grading so each matrix region reads as one zone.
c-region-material.fact_policy: Region tint is derived from matrix regions and does not change cells.

e-region-material-control.role: Structure sketch where every cell keeps its object but floor material is owned by region.
e-region-material-control.fact_policy: Control input only; not puzzle truth.

comparison.role: Side-by-side visual comparison of A/B/C routes.

d-sketch-oil-puzzle.role: Direct oil-painting translation of the asset-placement sketch.
d-sketch-oil-puzzle.fact_policy: Draft only; useful because it preserves cell semantics better than whole-scene generation.

e-region-material-oil-puzzle.role: Direct oil-painting translation of the region-material sketch.
e-region-material-oil-puzzle.prompt: Use the region-material control sketch as a strict 6x6 structure reference. Generate an oil-painted top-down puzzle-board map. Preserve every object in its exact cell, preserve straight grid lines, and make region identity obvious through floor material: garden grass, cafe light honey wood, library dark walnut wood, courtyard cool gray stone, workshop rough taupe stone, and inn amber wood. Do not add labels, letters, numbers, UI, characters, walls, doors, corridors, or a new room layout.
e-region-material-oil-puzzle.fact_policy: Draft only; region floor material comes from matrix region mapping.

direct-region-material-comparison.role: Side-by-side comparison of sketch-only oil output versus region-material oil output.

rules.truth_source: Puzzle JSON, matrices, solver output, and proof remain authoritative.
rules.floor_policy: Floors come from terrain/image layers; reusable object assets must not carry floor pixels.
rules.object_policy: Furniture, rugs, trees, shrubs, bookshelves, and fountain remain transparent object overlays.
rules.region_border_policy: Black borders are generated only from region matrix boundaries.
